questions.question: Describe the composite shape made by putting a triangle on top of a square, and say how many sides and lines of symmetry it has.
questions.expected_answer: It is a house shape made of a square and a triangle joined edge to edge. It has 5 outside sides, so it is a pentagon. If the triangle is centred, it has 1 vertical line of symmetry.

questions.question: Explain what a tessellation is and name two shapes that tessellate and one that does not.
questions.expected_answer: A tessellation is a pattern of shapes covering a flat surface with no gaps and no overlaps. Squares and regular hexagons tessellate. Circles do not, because they leave gaps.

questions.question: How can you make sure a shape you build from pattern blocks has a line of symmetry?
questions.expected_answer: Draw a line, then for every block placed on one side, place the same block as a mirror image on the other side. Test with an imagined fold: every piece must have a partner in the mirror position.
